title: refactor(core)!: retire 42 zero-consumer entry exports
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3DovMYxyWDWaMXs3JX16Av)_

Part of #25921. The umbrella stays open; this is barrel batch 5, claim 6670047779 (seat `domain:ui#6`, batch amendment from the seat after the census). Earlier batches: #30541, #30576, #30629, #30650.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/core` 的包入口不再导出 42 个名字，其中 `buildQueryAST` 与它包装的 `defaultQueryASTBuilder` 连同代码一起删掉，其余 40 个只离开入口、模块照旧。
- 为什么改：这 42 个名字在仓内（包外，含测试与文档）与 hotcrm 均零引用，README 未教，也不被保留导出的签名用到；被删的 2 个在包内也零读者，是死代码。本卡逐包收窄无人使用的公开导出。
- 风险与回滚：对外是 breaking 收窄，只影响直接从包入口 import 这些名字的外部宿主；控制台与所有 `@object-ui/*` 包不受影响。入口与内部子 barrel 的 `export *` 改成了具名列表，反向探针证明其余 476 个名字一个不少。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/index.ts`（11 处 `export *` 改具名列表，漏列即丢活名）、`ui/packages/core/src/actions/index.ts` 与 `evaluator/index.ts`（子 barrel 同类改写）、`.changeset/25921-core-zero-consumer-exports.md`（迁移说明）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -l -w -e buildQueryAST -e defaultQueryASTBuilder -e KNOWN_ACTION_KEYS -e isDebugEnabled -- ':!ui/packages/core' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 应只命中本 PR 的 changeset。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/core`, deleted (nothing inside the package read them either): `buildQueryAST` and the `defaultQueryASTBuilder` instance it wrapped, from `src/query/query-ast.ts`. Both were re-grepped on the new head: the only hits left are this PR's changeset.
- `@object-ui/core`, off the entry only (each module keeps its in-package readers):
  - `utils/column-identity`: `CANONICAL_COLUMN_IDENTITY_KEY`, `LEGACY_COLUMN_IDENTITY_KEYS`, `normalizeColumnIdentities`, `CANONICAL_COLUMN_LABEL_KEY` (dropped from the existing named list);
  - `utils/dom-props`: `isOpenDomAttributeFamily`; `utils/affordanceGrants`: type `AffordanceGrantRow`; `utils/column-sortability`: `normalizeObjectSortability`, `OBJECT_SORTABILITY_KEY`; `utils/action-activation`: `ACTION_SWITCHED_OFF_KEY`; `utils/cascade-delete-objects`: `CASCADE_DELETE_OBJECTS_KEY`; `utils/sort-values`: `compareCellValues`; `errors/index`: `isErrorCode`, `formatErrorMessage`; `utils/debug`: `isDebugEnabled`; `utils/filter-tokens`: type `ContextTokenName`; `utils/chart-series`: `isBuiltinAggregate`, `resolveMeasureLabel`, `resolveRelationshipTarget`, `resolveDimensionFieldOptions`, `INTEGER_AGGREGATES`; `utils/record-color`: `isColorLiteral`, `buildFieldColorMap`, type `FieldColorOption`. Those eleven `export *` lines in `src/index.ts` become named lists of their kept exports;
  - through the unpublished sub-barrels (`exports` has only `.`): `evaluator/index.ts` (`SUBJECT_PERMISSIONS`, `SUBJECT_CAPABILITIES`, `ROW_PREDICATE_CANONICAL_ROOT`; two `export *` lines become named lists), `actions/index.ts` (`NAVIGATION_ALIAS_KEYS`, `HOST_DISPATCH_ACTION_KEYS`, `KNOWN_ACTION_KEYS`, `classifyActionKeys`, `hasDeprecatedObjectParams`, `warnOnDeprecatedObjectParams` leave the `actionKeys` list; `isLegacyActionEnvelope`, `actionCopyText`, `fillTransitionalCopy` leave two `export *` lines turned named), `theme/index.ts` (`toCSSColor`, `generateTypographyVars`, `generateBorderRadiusVars`, `generateShadowVars`), `data-scope/index.ts` (`isElementDataSourceBlock`).
- Named lists were built from the TypeScript checker's export list. The first cut missed five names two modules re-export from `@objectstack/spec` (`CONTEXT_TOKENS` through `utils/filter-tokens`; `FIELD_UNSORTABLE_VIRTUAL_TYPE`, `FIELD_SORTABLE_UNPROVISIONED_ANCHOR`, `FieldSortability`, `ObjectSortability` through `utils/column-sortability`); the reverse probe caught them and the second commit puts them back.
- One test moves: `evaluator/__tests__/rowPredicateCanon.test.ts` imported `ROW_PREDICATE_CANONICAL_ROOT` from the evaluator barrel; it now imports the module and asserts the constant is off the barrel, beside the detector that stays.
- One new changeset, `.changeset/25921-core-zero-consumer-exports.md`: patch level, `!` title, BREAKING paragraph that says which names are gone from the package and which only left the entry, FROM/TO lines for every retired name, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` naming all 42 operands.

## Why

Card #25921 narrows `ui/packages` barrels to names someone imports. The checker export list after this PR is exactly the census list minus these 42 (518 to 476), nothing added.

## Tests

Census on `origin/main` 66a8822b with the method of batches 1 to 4: entry export names from the TypeScript checker over the built `dist/index.d.ts`; per name `git grep -l -w -F` outside the package, minus `**/CHANGELOG.md`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `.changeset/**` (test files and prose count), each zero re-run one name at a time; the package `*.md` and `demo/`; keep rule 3 (reached from a kept export's emitted declaration, walked through non-exported local declarations too, to a fixpoint); hotcrm `6961ab1`. Full table: project file `issue-25921-seat6/census-b5.md`.

| Package | Entry names | Zero outside hits | Kept (README, rule 3, or seat ruling) | Retired |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `@object-ui/core` | 518 | 116 | 74 (2 README, 67 rule 3, 5 by seat ruling) | 42 |

Kept by seat ruling, zero hits notwithstanding: `defaultObjectValidationEngine` (`validation/validators/index.ts` states the deprecated engine stays exported for host applications), and `SchemaError`, `RegistryError`, `ExpressionError`, `PluginError` (returned by the kept `createError`; a caller needs them for `instanceof`).

Controls (outside hits, same module as the retired names): `toDomProps` 111, `columnIdentity` 36, `buildChartSeries` 34, `resolveAffordance` 33, `elementDataSourceBlock` 37, `resolveFilterPlaceholders` 40, `isActionSwitchedOff` 15, `FieldValidationError` 11, `attachObjectSortability` 8, `getSortValue` 6, `interpretActionResponse` 6, `createFieldColorResolver` 6, `RETIRED_ACTION_KEYS` 5, `actionCopySource` 4, `QueryASTBuilder` 3, `subjectPermissionsOf` 3, `detectNonCanonicalRowSpelling` 3, `parseDebugFlags` 3, `attachCascadeDeleteObjects` 3, `hexToHSL` 2; hotcrm imports no `@object-ui/core` code but names it in prose (`ActionRunner` 2 files).

Readings at dea2c4bc (branch head after merging `origin/main` a2437b56; the same set first ran green at c21d361f before the merge):

<details><summary>Build, type-check, package tests</summary>

- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'`: 113 of 113 successful, under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core test`: Test Files 233 passed (233), Tests 4376 passed, 27 skipped (4403), exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Reverse check over every former entry name</summary>

A temporary `app-shell` probe re-exporting ALL 518 base entry names of `@object-ui/core` (types as `type`), `tsc --noEmit` in `ui/packages/app-shell` against the rebuilt `dist/index.d.ts`: exactly 42 errors (`TS2305` 27, `TS2724` 15, all in the probe), and the set of names they name is identical (`diff`) to the 42 retired names; the other 476 resolve. On the first cut the probe answered 47: it caught the five spec re-exports the named lists had dropped, fixed in the second commit. Probe deleted; `git status` clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 derived families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0 (among them `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:published-files`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, and `vitest run scripts/` in `ui/`: Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped (172), Tests 4970 passed, 2 skipped (4972)).
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: all 35 recorded an exit code).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, 0 anchored files in the change set.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood (narrowing arm)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock` on dea2c4bc: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 421 passed, 3 skipped (424); Tests 3513 passed, 36 skipped (3549); no failures.

</details>

Deleted names re-grepped on dea2c4bc: `buildQueryAST` and `defaultQueryASTBuilder` appear only in this PR's changeset. No ablation: export lines and two dead declarations only.

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing outside the card's surface was found.

## Verification

Reviewer: `git grep -l -w -e buildQueryAST -e defaultQueryASTBuilder -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` answers only this PR's changeset; the CI `Type Check UI` lane compiles every `@object-ui/*` consumer against the narrowed entry.
